//: Global facts about the website. Everything that appears on more than one page lives here rather than in the page fragments, because a value repeated across twenty-four pages drifts on the day one of them is edited alone. The generator (crates/site) refuses to emit a page that still contains an unresolved {{token}}, so a name removed from this file breaks the build instead of leaving a hole on a published page.
//languages: The first entry is the default: it owns the site root and is what hreflang x-default points at. Adding a language here without adding its file under i18n/ fails the build.
//theme: Taken from the product icon (assets/chrono-bean.svg), not chosen separately - #C0392B is the bean body and #E4573F its highlight. The background matches the application's dark theme.
social_image_alt: Chrono Mock - run a Windows application at any date and time, without changing the system clock
